cues.en: This is a pretty big course, so it's worth setting the stage about how all the different parts of it fit together.
cues.zh: 這門課內容相當豐富，先說明不同部分如何彼此銜接。

cues.en: To get started, we'll talk about the different kinds of recommender systems, the problems they try to solve, and the general architecture they tend to follow.
cues.zh: 一開始會介紹推薦系統的不同種類、它們要解決的問題，以及通常採用的一般架構。

cues.en: We'll then have a quick introduction to Python for people who have some programming experience but might be new to the Python language.
cues.zh: 接著，為有程式設計經驗、但可能不熟悉 Python 的人，快速介紹 Python。

cues.en: The next topic is evaluating recommender systems, defining what makes a good recommendation is in itself a complicated question, and it's important to decide what you're optimizing for.
cues.zh: 下一個主題是評估推薦系統。定義什麼是好的推薦，本身就是複雜的問題，因此必須決定要最佳化的目標。

cues.en: We'll then build a software framework for generating and evaluating recommendations using real data, and using different recommendation algorithms.
cues.zh: 然後，我們會建立軟體框架，運用真實資料與不同推薦演算法，產生並評估推薦。

cues.en: Throughout the rest of the course, we'll use this framework to quickly implement and evaluate new ideas.
cues.zh: 課程其餘部分都會利用這個框架，快速實作與評估新的想法。

cues.en: Content-based filtering will show us how we can recommend items to people just based on the attributes of the items themselves.
cues.zh: 內容式過濾會展示，如何只根據項目本身的屬性，將項目推薦給使用者。

cues.en: Neighborhood-based collaborative filtering gets into the classic behavior-based recommendation approach pioneered by Amazon that's still in widespread use today.
cues.zh: 鄰域式協同過濾會深入探討 Amazon 開創、至今仍廣泛使用的經典行為式推薦方法。

cues.en: We then move into more modern, model-based methods that generally rely on matrix factorization approaches to generate recommendations.
cues.zh: 接著進入較現代的模型式方法，這些方法通常仰賴矩陣分解來產生推薦。

cues.en: Then, it's time to bust out the neural networks.
cues.zh: 然後就輪到神經網路登場。

cues.en: If you're new to deep learning, we have a section that will get you up to speed on modern neural networks.
cues.zh: 如果你不熟悉深度學習，有一個章節會帶你認識現代神經網路。

cues.en: And then we'll go through several examples of using deep learning to generate recommendations, and the challenges that are specific to recommender systems when using deep learning.
cues.zh: 接著會透過多個範例，運用深度學習產生推薦，並介紹推薦系統使用深度學習時特有的挑戰。

cues.en: Next, we'll scale things up to massive data sets.
cues.zh: 下一步，我們要擴展到大規模資料集。

cues.en: We'll learn how to use Amazon Web Services, Apache Spark, and some exciting new technology open-sourced by Amazon to generate recommendations for millions of people across catalogs of millions of items.
cues.zh: 我們會學習使用 Amazon Web Services、Apache Spark，以及 Amazon 開源的一些令人期待的新技術，從數百萬個項目中，為數百萬人產生推薦。

cues.en: We'll then discuss some of the real-world challenges you'll encounter when deploying recommender systems for real times, to real people and some of the solutions that work for them.
cues.zh: 接著討論把推薦系統實際部署給真實使用者時，會遇到的實務挑戰，以及有效的解決方法。

cues.en: We continue to keep it real by looking at case studies of how recommender systems work at YouTube and Netflix, which ties together many of the concepts covered earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 我們繼續聚焦實務，研究 YouTube 與 Netflix 的推薦系統案例，將課程前面許多概念串連起來。

cues.en: Finally, we'll look at hybrid solutions that allow us to combine many different recommender systems together into one that's even more powerful, and we'll wrap things up with tips on how you can continue
cues.zh: 最後，介紹混合式解決方案，將多種不同推薦系統組合成更強大的系統，並以一些建議收尾，幫助你持續

cues.en: your education and research into recommender systems as the field continues to evolve over time.
cues.zh: 學習與研究推薦系統，跟上這個領域的演進。

cues.en: This is a very comprehensive course, covering some of the latest research and practical implementation tips in the field.
cues.zh: 這門課內容相當完整，涵蓋這個領域的一些最新研究與實務實作訣竅。

cues.en: And throughout the course, you'll have hands-on examples all along the way to see what you've learned in action and individual exercises to allow you to practice what you've learned on your own.
cues.zh: 全程都有實作範例，讓你看到所學如何運作，也有個人練習，讓你自行練習所學。

cues.en: A quick note about how to use this course depending on your previous experience.
cues.zh: 簡單說明一下，如何根據你既有的經驗使用這門課。

cues.en: This course is intended to be usable by anybody with some background in computer science, but not necessarily people who already know Python specifically or who have prior experience
cues.zh: 本課程希望讓任何具備資訊科學背景的人都能上手，不一定需要熟悉 Python，也不一定要有

cues.en: with neural networks and deep learning.
cues.zh: 神經網路與深度學習的經驗。

cues.en: If you already have experience in these fields, it's okay to skip these sections of the course.
cues.zh: 如果你已經有這些領域的經驗，可以跳過相關章節。

cues.en: Nothing happens in the intro to Python or intro to deep learning sections that later sections build upon.
cues.zh: 後續章節並不會建立在 Python 入門或深度學習入門章節的實作成果上。

cues.en: If you already know Python, you can skip that whole section and proceed through the rest of the course just fine.
cues.zh: 如果已經會 Python，可以略過整個 Python 章節，直接繼續其餘課程。

cues.en: And if you are already familiar with neural networks, Tensorflow, and recurrent neural networks, you can skip the intro to deep learning section or at least the portions of it that you're already familiar with.
cues.zh: 如果已經熟悉神經網路、TensorFlow 與循環神經網路，也可以略過深度學習入門，或至少略過已經熟悉的部分。

cues.en: Hey, Frank Kane here from the Sundog Education course recording studio.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是 Frank Kane，目前在 Sundog Education 的課程錄影室。

cues.en: Now depending on what platform you're watching this course on, you might be prompted for a review of it right after this lecture or maybe the next one, and I hope you're enjoying it so far,
cues.zh: 依照你觀看課程的平台，這堂或下一堂講座結束後，可能就會提示你留下評價。希望你目前喜歡這門課，

cues.en: but if you need more time to really form an opinion, there should be a little ask me later button on there too, so if you're not sure about this course yet and you wanna give it some more time,
cues.zh: 不過，如果需要更多時間才能形成看法，應該也有一個「稍後再問我」的小按鈕。如果還不確定，想多看一點，

cues.en: feel free to hit that and they'll prompt you for a review later on in the course where you'll have more of it under your belt to form an opinion with.
cues.zh: 盡管按下它。稍後修課內容更多、有充分依據後，系統會再提示你評價。

cues.en: Really important to me that you leave an honest and well informed review of this course because reviews are really critical to instructors like me who make their livelihood off of this stuff.
cues.zh: 請留下真實且有充分了解的評價，這對我非常重要，因為像我這種以製作課程為生的講師，非常仰賴評價。

cues.en: Anyhow, hope you've enjoyed what you've seen so far, and let's just keep on goin'.
cues.zh: 總之，希望你喜歡目前看到的內容，我們繼續吧。
